name: gizmo-rotate-multitouch
description: MOBILE-1: a second finger's independent pointer stream must not hijack an in-progress RotateGizmo drag (the same BUG-1 class already fixed for furniture drag in DragController). Selects a single item inside the room editor (canEditScene requires orbit + room editor), projects the rotate-gizmo knob's world position to screen pixels via the dev __three camera, grabs it with pointerId 9 (mirroring RotateGizmo.onGrab's captured e.nativeEvent.pointerId), drives it with a real pointermove, then asserts a second pointer (id 202) moving/releasing is completely ignored: the item's rotation follows ONLY pointer 9, and only pointer 9's pointerup ends the gesture (rotatingGizmo -> false, pendingEdit armed).

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays

steps.name: seed-and-select
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.setItems([{ id: 'rot-gizmo-sofa', defId: 'sofa-3seat', position: [10.5, 4.1], rotation: 0, props: {} }]); s.selectItem('rot-gizmo-sofa'); })()

steps.name: compute-handle-screen-pos
steps.eval: (() => { function applyM4(x,y,z,e){ const w=1/(e[3]*x+e[7]*y+e[11]*z+e[15]); return [ (e[0]*x+e[4]*y+e[8]*z+e[12])*w, (e[1]*x+e[5]*y+e[9]*z+e[13])*w, (e[2]*x+e[6]*y+e[10]*z+e[14])*w ]; } function worldToClient(wx,wy,wz){ const cam=window.__three.camera; cam.updateMatrixWorld(); const dom=window.__three.gl.domElement; const v1=applyM4(wx,wy,wz,cam.matrixWorldInverse.elements); const v2=applyM4(v1[0],v1[1],v1[2],cam.projectionMatrix.elements); const rect=dom.getBoundingClientRect(); return { x: rect.left+(v2[0]*0.5+0.5)*rect.width, y: rect.top+(1-(v2[1]*0.5+0.5))*rect.height }; } window.__worldToClient = worldToClient; const hx=2.1/2, hz=0.9/2; const radius=Math.max(0.55, Math.max(hx,hz)+0.38); window.__rgRadius = radius; window.__tgt = worldToClient(10.5, 0.02, 4.1 + radius); })()

steps.name: handle-onscreen

waitFor.store: (() => { const r=window.__three.gl.domElement.getBoundingClientRect(); const t=window.__tgt; return t && t.x>=r.left && t.x<=r.right && t.y>=r.top && t.y<=r.bottom; })()

steps.failMessage: projected rotate-gizmo knob screen position fell outside the canvas — camera framing or radius math drifted

steps.name: grab-knob-pointer-9
steps.eval: (() => { const dom=window.__three.gl.domElement; const t=window.__tgt; const opt=(x,y)=>({bubbles:true,cancelable:true,composed:true,pointerId:9,pointerType:'touch',isPrimary:true,button:0,buttons:1,clientX:x,clientY:y}); dom.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', opt(t.x, t.y))); })()

steps.name: finger-2-pointerdown-and-move-far-away
steps.eval: (() => { const opt=(x,y)=>({bubbles:true,cancelable:true,composed:true,pointerId:202,pointerType:'touch',isPrimary:false,button:0,buttons:1,clientX:x,clientY:y}); window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', opt(20, 20))); window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', opt(20, 20))); })()

steps.name: assert-second-finger-ignored
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); const r=s.items.find(i=>i.id==='rot-gizmo-sofa').rotation; const a=window.__rgAfterFinger1; if (Math.abs(r-a) > 1e-6) throw new Error('MOBILE-1 REGRESSION: rotate gizmo followed the second finger (pointerId 202) — expected rotation to stay at '+a+' but got '+r); if (s.rotatingGizmo !== true) throw new Error('gesture was cleared by the second finger') })()

steps.name: assert-gesture-still-active-after-finger-2-up
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); if (s.rotatingGizmo !== true) throw new Error('MOBILE-1 REGRESSION: the second finger (pointerId 202) releasing ended the rotate gesture — only the initiating pointer (9) may end it') })()

steps.name: assert-gesture-ended-by-initiating-pointer
steps.failMessage: rotate gesture did not end + arm the tick/cross pendingEdit on the initiating pointer (9) releasing

steps.name: assert-final-rotation-is-finger-1s
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); const r=s.items.find(i=>i.id==='rot-gizmo-sofa').rotation; const a=window.__rgAfterFinger1; if (Math.abs(r-a) > 1e-6) throw new Error('committed rotation ('+r+') does not match finger 1 (pointerId 9)\'s driven value ('+a+') — the second finger may have corrupted the committed transform') })()
